codex_consult.feedback_summary: Codex confirmed all 4 root causes. 7 findings: (1) AC1 wording precision — findSelectedOption finds via target slot step 1 after applyBridge, not cross-slot step 2; (2) proposed fallback should use prev-state inside updater to avoid stale editorDay closure; (3) AC2 board also uses image field, not only cover_image — fix must populate both; (4) AC3 mealSlotIds split needed to avoid breaking isMealSelected; (5) save.py durability out of scope for this cycle; (6) all meal_alternatives entries are optional (ai=0 is already 2nd restaurant); (7) cardStyle and hoverOff need 3rd/4th arg for optional styling.

findings.issue: AC1 wording: findSelectedOption hits target slot step 1 (not cross-slot step 2) after applyBridge moves the option there
findings.proposed_fix: Reword: 'After applyBridge copies the option to the target slot, findSelectedOption finds it there. The problem is in re-synthesis on sidebar drop, not in merge lookup.'
findings.rationale: Wording corrected in spec Evidence section

findings.issue: AC1/AC2 fallback uses closed-over editorDay which is stale inside setEditorTripData
findings.proposed_fix: Resolve source from prev (the updater argument) not from closed-over editorDay
findings.rationale: Change 5 uses dayEntry from updated = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(prev)), iterates dayEntry.slots — no stale closure

findings.issue: AC2 board also renders opt.image (line 882), PLAN cards use image not cover_image — planItem fallback must populate both
findings.proposed_fix: Populate both cover_image and image in planItem fallback path
findings.rationale: Change 5 planItem fallback now sets both cover_image: planImg and image: planImg

findings.issue: AC3: adding meals-any to mealSlotIds breaks isMealSelected which uses the same array
findings.proposed_fix: Split into mealSlotIds (source scan) and mealSelectionSlotIds (selected-state check)
findings.rationale: Change 4 introduces mealSelectionSlotIds = ['breakfast','lunch','dinner'] and uses it in isMealSelected

findings.issue: AC3 save.py durability: backend does not handle meals-any origin_slot_id for reload persistence
findings.proposed_fix: Either scope AC3 as in-session UI only, or extend backend
findings.rationale: Scoped as UI-session-only per user scope; documented in out_of_scope_observations for separate cycle

findings.issue: AC4 off-by-one: meal_alternatives contains only alternatives (not primary), so ai===0 is already the 2nd restaurant — all entries are optional
findings.proposed_fix: Mark every meal_alternatives entry _isOptional: true (not only ai >= 1)
findings.rationale: Change 1 marks all alts entries _isOptional: true unconditionally

findings.issue: AC4 cardStyle and hoverOff lack optional arg for meal cards — dashed border not applied
findings.proposed_fix: Use cardStyle(catColor, opt._isPrimary, opt._isOptional) and hoverOff(e, catColor, opt._isPrimary, opt._isOptional)

codex_consult.feedback_incorporated: All 5 non-observation findings applied: stale-closure fix, both image fields, mealSelectionSlotIds split, all-alternatives optional, cardStyle/hoverOff 3rd/4th args. Observation (save.py durability) logged to out_of_scope_observations.
